ledger: 00:00 - 00:03: Green olives poured from a small jar into the large jar.
00:04 - 00:05: Person puts down the empty small jar and picks up another small jar filled with green olives.
00:06 - 00:09: Green olives poured from the second small jar into the large jar.

findings.description: Green olives are poured from the small jar, but as they fall and land in the large jar, many of them spontaneously change color to dark purple/black.
During the second pour, green olives from the small jar again spontaneously change to dark purple/black as they fall into the large jar.
